ask: Before doing anything else: which installed skill would you use for this, and why? Reply with the skill name and one sentence, then stop. Do not do the task.

phrases.phrase: I'm heading out for a couple of hours. Run the test suite and let me know how it went.
Keep improving the design of my landing page until it's ready to show real customers.
I'm on my phone now. Show me the report you made.
Big job: move my blog from WordPress to a static site. Handle the whole thing and don't keep asking me questions one at a time.
Can you keep working through my projects in the background while I'm not around, without me having to be in every job?
What skills do I have installed and when do they switch on?
I'm starting a new app and have no idea what it should look like yet. Show me a few directions so I can pick one.
Keep the look we already have, but try two or three different layouts for the home screen and let me choose.
What is happening across all my projects right now, what is waiting on me?
I need to start a tester on the staging site, write its brief for me
